description: Internal combined wind and tide operations dashboard for SSA Marine / Victoria Harbor. Includes customer-style forecasts, observations, verification, freshness, completeness, and ingestion diagnostics.

panels.description: Status checks for forecast horizon, tide observations, wind observations, and tide verification freshness.

targets.rawSql:
WITH metrics AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT MAX(forecastdtutc) FROM public.forecast_data WHERE group_id = 'grp_ssamarine' AND locname = '$location' AND model = 'tide_nbm' AND tidemean IS NOT NULL) AS latest_tide_forecast,
    (SELECT MAX(forecastdtutc) FROM public.forecast_data WHERE group_id = 'grp_ssamarine' AND locname = '$location' AND model = 'tide_nbm' AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL) AS latest_wind_forecast,
    (SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM public.forecast_data WHERE group_id = 'grp_ssamarine' AND locname = '$location' AND model = 'tide_astro' AND prelimtide IS NOT NULL) AS latest_tide_observation,
    (SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM public.forecast_data WHERE group_id = 'grp_ssamarine' AND locname = '$location' AND obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL) AS latest_wind_speed_observation,
    (SELECT MAX(timestamp) FROM public.v_forecast_verification WHERE variable = 'tide' AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine' AND locname = '$location') AS latest_tide_verification
)
SELECT 'Tide forecast horizon' AS "Check",
       CASE WHEN latest_tide_forecast >= NOW() THEN 'OK' ELSE 'STALE' END AS "Status",
       latest_tide_forecast AS "Timestamp",
       latest_tide_forecast - NOW() AS "Lead/Lag"
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Wind forecast horizon',
       CASE WHEN latest_wind_forecast >= NOW() THEN 'OK' ELSE 'STALE' END,
       latest_wind_forecast,
       latest_wind_forecast - NOW()
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Tide observations',
       CASE WHEN latest_tide_observation >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN 'OK' ELSE 'STALE/MISSING' END,
       latest_tide_observation,
       NOW() - latest_tide_observation
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Wind observations',
       CASE WHEN latest_wind_speed_observation IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' WHEN latest_wind_speed_observation >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN 'OK' ELSE 'STALE' END,
       latest_wind_speed_observation,
       CASE WHEN latest_wind_speed_observation IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE NOW() - latest_wind_speed_observation END
FROM metrics
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Tide verification',
       CASE WHEN latest_tide_verification >= NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN 'OK' ELSE 'STALE/MISSING' END,
       latest_tide_verification,
       NOW() - latest_tide_verification
FROM metrics

panels.title: Forecast & Observation Freshness

panels.description: Row counts, run counts, forecast range, and latest ingest time by model.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model AS "Model",
       COUNT(*) AS "Rows",
       COUNT(DISTINCT startdt) AS "Runs",
       MAX(startdt) AS "Latest startdt",
       MIN(forecastdtutc) AS "First forecast time",
       MAX(forecastdtutc) AS "Last forecast time",
       MAX(created_at) AS "Latest ingest"
FROM public.forecast_data
WHERE group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND (tidemean IS NOT NULL OR windspdmean IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY model

panels.title: Forecast Cycle Metadata

panels.description: Missing-value counts for the latest combined tide_nbm run.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(startdt) AS startdt
  FROM public.forecast_data
  WHERE group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND model = 'tide_nbm'
    AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 'tide_nbm latest run' AS "Scope",
       l.startdt AS "Startdt",
       COUNT(*) AS "Rows",
       MIN(f.forecastdtutc) AS "First forecast",
       MAX(f.forecastdtutc) AS "Last forecast",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.tidemean IS NULL) AS "Missing tide mean",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.windspdmean IS NULL) AS "Missing wind speed",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.winddirmean IS NULL) AS "Missing wind direction",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.tidelb IS NULL OR f.tideub IS NULL OR f.windspdlb IS NULL OR f.windspdub IS NULL) AS "Missing bounds"
FROM latest l
JOIN public.forecast_data f
  ON f.group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
 AND f.locname = '$location'
 AND f.model = 'tide_nbm'
 AND f.startdt = l.startdt
GROUP BY l.startdt

panels.title: Observation Availability

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS "time",
    windspdmean,
    windspdlb,
    windspdub,
    winddirmean
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE
    windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' NOT IN ('wind_nbm', 'tide_nbm')
    AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 10))
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    forecastdtutc AS "time",
    windspdmean,
    windspdlb,
    windspdub,
    winddirmean
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE
    windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND '$model' IN ('wind_nbm', 'tide_nbm')
    AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 10))
    AND startdt = (
      SELECT MAX(startdt)
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
        AND model = '$model'
        AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 10))
        AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
        AND forecastdtutc >= $__timeFrom()
    )
)
SELECT
  src."time",
  src.windspdmean,
  src.windspdlb,
  src.windspdub,
  w.v1_s0 AS winddirmean,
  w.v1_sm1 AS winddirmean_sm1,
  w.v1_sp1 AS winddirmean_sp1,
  (MOD(MOD(src.winddirmean::numeric, 360) + 360, 360))::float AS winddir_tooltip
FROM src
JOIN public.fn_wrap_directions(
  (SELECT array_agg("time" ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddirmean ORDER BY "time") FROM src)
) w USING ("time")
ORDER BY src."time"

panels.title: Wind Forecast (${height_m} m)
panels.description: Wind speed forecast with predicted wind direction on the right y-axis. Direction uses wrapped shifted copies to avoid false 360-to-0 jumps.
Current UTC and forecast-location local time for the latest wind sample at this height.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(timestamp) AS ts
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 10))
    AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
)
SELECT 'UTC' AS "Label", to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Time"
FROM latest
WHERE ts IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Local' AS "Label", to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE '$location_tz', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Time"
FROM latest
WHERE ts IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  windspdmean
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 10))
  AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
ORDER BY timestamp DESC, startdt DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Gusts (${height_m}m)
panels.description: Most recent gusts at-or-before now (${height_m} m).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  locname AS "Location",
  COALESCE(height_m, 10) AS "Height (m)",
  timestamp AS "Last Updated",
  windspdmean AS "Wind Speed"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (locname, COALESCE(height_m, 10))
    locname,
    height_m,
    timestamp,
    windspdmean
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
    AND model = '$model'
    AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  ORDER BY locname, COALESCE(height_m, 10), timestamp DESC, startdt DESC NULLS LAST
) sub
ORDER BY locname, "Height (m)"

panels.title: Wind Speed by Location and Height

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  tidemean_display,
  tidelb_display,
  tideub_display
FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
WHERE
  tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' NOT IN ('tide_nbm', 'tide_blend')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "time",
  tidemean_display,
  tidelb_display,
  tideub_display
FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
WHERE
  tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' IN ('tide_nbm', 'tide_blend')
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
      AND model = '$model'
      AND tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
        AND forecastdtutc >= $__timeFrom()
  )
ORDER BY "time"

WITH nearest_points AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    tidemean_display,
    LEAD(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS next_timestamp,
    LEAD(tidemean_display) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS next_tidemean
  FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
  WHERE
    tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
    AND model = '$model'
  ORDER BY timestamp
)
SELECT
  NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ AS "time",
  CASE
    WHEN next_timestamp IS NULL THEN tidemean_display
    WHEN NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ >= next_timestamp THEN next_tidemean
    ELSE tidemean_display + (next_tidemean - tidemean_display) * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ - timestamp)) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_timestamp - timestamp)), 0)
  END AS tidemean_display
FROM nearest_points
WHERE timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH nearest_points AS (
  SELECT
    locname,
    datum,
    timestamp,
    tidemean_display,
    LEAD(timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY locname ORDER BY timestamp) AS next_timestamp,
    LEAD(tidemean_display) OVER (PARTITION BY locname ORDER BY timestamp) AS next_tidemean
  FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
  WHERE
    tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
    AND model = '$model'
), interpolated AS (
  SELECT
    locname AS "Location",
    NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ AS "Current Time",
    CASE
      WHEN next_timestamp IS NULL THEN tidemean_display
      WHEN NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ >= next_timestamp THEN next_tidemean
      ELSE tidemean_display + (next_tidemean - tidemean_display) * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ - timestamp)) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_timestamp - timestamp)), 0)
    END AS "Predicted Value",
    datum AS "Datum",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY locname ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS row_num
  FROM nearest_points
  WHERE timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
)
SELECT
  "Location",
  "Current Time",
  "Predicted Value",
  "Datum"
FROM interpolated
WHERE row_num = 1
ORDER BY "Location"

SELECT
  timestamp AS "Date (${__timezone})",
  tidemean_display AS "Predicted Value",
  tideub_display AS "Tide Upper Bound",
  tidelb_display AS "Tide Lower Bound"
FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
WHERE
  tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' NOT IN ('tide_nbm', 'tide_blend')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "Date (${__timezone})",
  tidemean_display AS "Predicted Value",
  tideub_display AS "Tide Upper Bound",
  tidelb_display AS "Tide Lower Bound"
FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
WHERE
  tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
  AND model = '$model'
  AND '$model' IN ('tide_nbm', 'tide_blend')
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
      AND model = '$model'
      AND tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
        AND forecastdtutc >= $__timeFrom()
  )
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Tide forecast, astronomical reference, preliminary observations, and latest NBM forecast in display meters.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  tidemean_display,
  astrotide_display,
  prelimtide_display
FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
WHERE

  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
  AND model = 'tide_astro'
  AND timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
ORDER BY timestamp

SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "time",
  tidemean_display AS "NBM Forecast"
FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
WHERE
  tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
  AND model = 'tide_nbm'
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM public.v_forecast_data_display
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
      AND model = 'tide_nbm'
      AND tidemean_display IS NOT NULL
        AND forecastdtutc >= $__timeFrom()

ORDER BY forecastdtutc

panels.title: NBM Wind Forcing Diagnostic

panels.description: Verification from v_forecast_verification converted from feet to meters for consistency with the display-unit preference.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "time", "Forecast (mean)", "Forecast (NBM)", "Observed", "Wind speed (lower bound)", "Wind speed (upper bound)"
FROM (
  -- Branch 1: non-NBM models — timestamp is valid time axis
  SELECT
    f."timestamp" AS "time",
    f.windspdmean AS "Forecast (mean)",
    f.windspd     AS "Forecast (NBM)",
    o.obs_wspd_kt AS "Observed",
    f.windspdlb   AS "Wind speed (lower bound)",
    f.windspdub   AS "Wind speed (upper bound)"
  FROM forecast_data f
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.obs_wspd_kt
    FROM forecast_data o
    WHERE o.group_id = f.group_id
      AND o.locname = f.locname
      AND o."timestamp" = f."timestamp"
      AND COALESCE(o.height_m, 10) = COALESCE(f.height_m, 10)
      AND o.fhr = 0
      AND o.model IN (f.model, 'model_1')
      AND o.obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.model = f.model THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
  WHERE f.windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND f.startdt IS NOT NULL
    AND f.group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
    AND f.locname = '$location'
    AND f.model = '$model'
    AND '$model' NOT IN ('tide_nbm', 'wind_nbm', 'tide_blend')
    AND (COALESCE(f.height_m, 10) IN ($height_m) OR $height_m = '$__all')
    AND f."timestamp" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '7 days'
    AND f."timestamp" <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
  UNION ALL
  -- Branch 2: NBM models — use forecastdtutc + latest startdt
  SELECT
    f.forecastdtutc AS "time",
    f.windspdmean AS "Forecast (mean)",
    f.windspd     AS "Forecast (NBM)",
    o.obs_wspd_kt AS "Observed",
    f.windspdlb   AS "Wind speed (lower bound)",
    f.windspdub   AS "Wind speed (upper bound)"
  FROM forecast_data f
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT o.obs_wspd_kt
    FROM forecast_data o
    WHERE o.group_id = f.group_id
      AND o.locname = f.locname
      AND o."timestamp" = f."timestamp"
      AND COALESCE(o.height_m, 10) = COALESCE(f.height_m, 10)
      AND o.fhr = 0
      AND o.model IN (f.model, 'model_1')
      AND o.obs_wspd_kt IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.model = f.model THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
    LIMIT 1
  ) o ON true
  WHERE f.windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND f.startdt IS NOT NULL
    AND f.group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
    AND f.locname = '$location'
    AND f.model = '$model'
    AND '$model' IN ('tide_nbm', 'wind_nbm', 'tide_blend')
    AND f.startdt = (
      -- Scalar subquery — PG evaluates this once, not per row
      SELECT MAX(startdt)
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
        AND model = '$model'
        AND (COALESCE(height_m, 10) IN ($height_m) OR $height_m = '$__all')
        AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
        AND forecastdtutc >= $__timeFrom()
    )
    AND (COALESCE(f.height_m, 10) IN ($height_m) OR $height_m = '$__all')
    AND f.forecastdtutc >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - INTERVAL '7 days'
    AND f.forecastdtutc <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
) sub
ORDER BY "time"

panels.title: Wind Forecast vs Observations
panels.description: Ensemble mean wind speed forecast, NBM deterministic forecast, and observed wind speed from matched fhr=0 rows.
Verification from v_forecast_verification converted from feet to meters for consistency with the display-unit preference.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model AS "Model",
       COUNT(*) AS "N",
       AVG(error * 0.3048) AS "Bias (m)",
       AVG(ABS(error) * 0.3048) AS "MAE (m)",
       SQRT(AVG(error * error)) * 0.3048 AS "RMSE (m)",
       AVG(in_envelope::float) FILTER (WHERE forecast_lb IS NOT NULL) AS "In-envelope"
FROM public.v_forecast_verification
WHERE variable = 'tide'
  AND group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY model

panels.title: Tide Verification Metrics (last 7 days)

panels.description: Detects unusually large forecast-time gaps by model/run.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT model,
         forecastdtutc,
         forecastdtutc - LAG(forecastdtutc) OVER (PARTITION BY model, startdt ORDER BY forecastdtutc) AS gap
  FROM public.forecast_data
  WHERE group_id = 'grp_ssamarine'
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND model IN ('tide_nbm', 'tide_astro')
    AND (tidemean IS NOT NULL OR windspdmean IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT model AS "Model",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE gap > INTERVAL '1 hour 30 minutes') AS "Gaps > 90 min",
       MAX(gap) AS "Largest gap",
       MIN(forecastdtutc) AS "First forecast",
       MAX(forecastdtutc) AS "Last forecast"
FROM ordered
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY model
